{"rationale":"carol.tan@eproc.test used the break-glass dba role outside her normal hours (01:45–02:05 UTC vs baseline 08:00–17:00) with no evident change ticket. She created role svc_reporting and granted it SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public, which bypasses analyst_ro column-level restrictions and exposes sensitive columns (salary, national_id, bank_account, tax_id, unsealed bid data). Although the role was dropped at session end, the 16-minute window could have been exploited by a parallel session. A short Teleport lock (4 h, auto-expiring) is placed on carol.tan@eproc.test to pause access while a human investigates, and forensic SQL verifies cleanup completeness, captures residual default-ACL entries, preserves the session audit trail, and checks for any svc_reporting logins during the exposure window.","language":"bash","script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Temporarily lock the principal in Teleport
tctl lock \
  --user=carol.tan@eproc.test \
  --ttl=4h \
  --message="ALRT-0012: Unscheduled break-glass dba session with shadow role svc_reporting created outside change window (01:45-02:05 UTC). Pending investigation."

# 2. Forensic checks in the database
psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 <<'EOSQL'
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  check_name text NOT NULL,
  result jsonb,
  checked_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Verify svc_reporting role no longer exists
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, result)
SELECT 'role_exists_check',
       jsonb_build_object('svc_reporting_exists',
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'svc_reporting'));

-- Capture all current default-ACL entries in public schema to detect residual grants
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, result)
SELECT 'residual_default_acl',
       COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'grantor_oid', defaclrole,
         'objtype', defaclobjtype,
         'acl', defaclacl::text
       )), '[]'::jsonb)
FROM pg_default_acl
WHERE defaclnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace;

-- Preserve carol.tan full session trail from audit_log
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, result)
SELECT 'carol_session_audit',
       COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb)
FROM public.audit_log a
WHERE a.session_id = 'd15b2cfa-4f8d-440e-8fcb-75844ef5281a';

-- Check whether any session authenticated as svc_reporting during the exposure window
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, result)
SELECT 'svc_reporting_logins',
       COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb)
FROM public.audit_log a
WHERE a.db_user = 'svc_reporting'
  AND a.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-12T01:45:00Z' AND '2026-08-12T02:10:00Z';

COMMIT;
